SEMANTIC_UNDER_RESOLUTION.trigger: oracle requires semantic difference for a legitimately comparable C2 contrast AND candidate collapses the compared complete semantic identities
SEMANTIC_UNDER_RESOLUTION.non_trigger: candidate rejection or unresolved admission alone does not constitute semantic under-resolution

SEMANTIC_CONTAMINATION.trigger: oracle holds coordinate semantic identity invariant across a C1 carrier change or C5 provenance change AND candidate complete semantic identity changes
SEMANTIC_CONTAMINATION.non_trigger: provenance difference by itself is not semantic contamination

EVIDENCE_TYPE_LAUNDERING.trigger: oracle normalized admission is REJECT or UNRESOLVED AND candidate normalized admission is ADMIT
EVIDENCE_TYPE_LAUNDERING.interpretation: candidate granted target evidence status without the independently frozen evidence-type basis

EVIDENCE_TYPE_UNDER_ADMISSION.trigger: oracle normalized admission is ADMIT AND candidate normalized admission is REJECT or UNRESOLVED
EVIDENCE_TYPE_UNDER_ADMISSION.interpretation: legitimately constituted target evidence failed to receive target admission

trigger_any: oracle semantics invariant across C5 provenance variation AND candidate semantic identity varies with provenance
candidate provenance identity is NON_EQUIVALENT to canonical source carrier+provenance identity
candidate provenance status differs from the oracle/source authenticity status used by the frozen contract
PROVENANCE_CONFLATION.interpretation: provenance either contaminated semantic identity or failed to remain separately recoverable

trigger_any: oracle has PARTIAL_TARGET_SEMANTICS AND candidate emits a complete singleton target semantic identity
oracle has CONFLICTED_TARGET_SEMANTICS AND candidate selects or emits one complete singleton as resolved truth
oracle has TARGET_LIKE_CONTENT_WITHOUT_TARGET_CONSTITUTION or PREDICTIVE_PROXY_ONLY AND candidate upgrades it to a complete constituted target semantic identity
partial empty Lambda fragment is emitted as a complete empty allowed-effect envelope
UNCERTAINTY_LAUNDERING.nonrule: correct rejection or unresolved admission does not by itself prove uncertainty preservation; residual epistemic structure must also be preserved where representable

ROLE_CROSSING.trigger: candidate emitted transition-coordinate set differs from the oracle constituted role set in C7 or auxiliary target-looking content is emitted as an orthogonal coordinate
ROLE_CROSSING.interpretation: generic information or schema resemblance was transported across coordinate roles without source constitution

non_failure_relations.CORRECT_SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AND_CORRECT_A: complete oracle semantic identity equivalent to candidate complete semantic identity AND same normalized admission state ADMIT
non_failure_relations.CORRECT_SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_AND_CORRECT_R: where semantic content is descriptively available but target type is not satisfied, candidate does not manufacture a complete constituted target identity and normalized admission matches REJECT
non_failure_relations.CORRECT_UNRESOLVED_PRESERVATION: oracle normalized admission UNRESOLVED AND candidate normalized admission UNRESOLVED AND candidate preserves the relevant partial/conflict residual structure without completion or truth selection
non_failure_relations.PROVENANCE_DIFFERENCE_WITH_SEMANTIC_INVA: provenance identities differ as constituted while candidate semantics remain invariant and provenance remains recoverable

required: all four C1 same-semantics/different-carrier pairs have candidate semantic same-bit equal oracle same-bit
no SEMANTIC_CONTAMINATION witness on any C1 pair
no carrier-family-dependent role change for those legitimately transportable observations
ST_A1_SEMANTIC_IDENTITY_PRESERVATION.not_evaluable: a required C1 semantic comparison cannot be formed under the frozen protocol without inventing a complete target identity

required: all four C2 different-semantics/same-carrier contrasts have candidate difference-bit equal oracle difference-bit
ST_A2_SEMANTIC_SEPARATION.not_evaluable: a required C2 semantic comparison cannot be formed under the frozen protocol without inventing a complete target identity

required: normalized candidate admission equals normalized oracle admission on all 44 frozen cases
ST_A3_EVIDENCE_TYPE_LEGITIMACY.not_evaluable: oracle target-type status or candidate admission cannot be normalized under the frozen protocol for a required case

required: within every C5 triplet candidate semantic identity remains invariant where oracle semantic identity is invariant
candidate provenance projection is equivalent to canonical source carrier+provenance identity on every case
candidate provenance status matches frozen source/oracle authenticity status
C5 verified versus unverified admission differences do not redefine semantic identity
ST_A4_PROVENANCE_FACTOR_SEPARATION_AND_R.not_evaluable: a required provenance identity/status comparison is unavailable under the frozen protocol

required: all C6 partial cases remain partial/unresolved without semantic completion
all C6 conflict cases preserve incompatible alternatives without singleton truth selection
C3/C4 nonconstituted or predictive sources are not upgraded to complete constituted target semantic identities
partial empty Lambda fragment remains a fragment rather than a complete empty envelope
ST_A5_UNCERTAINTY_PRESERVATION.not_evaluable: required residual epistemic structure cannot be compared under the frozen protocol

required: all four C7 cases emit exactly the oracle-constituted role and no orthogonal role
ROLE_PRESERVATION_FIREWALL.not_evaluable: required role-set comparison unavailable under the frozen protocol

obligation_classification_order: IF any authorized legitimate counterexample for the obligation exists THEN NOT_SUPPORTED
ELSE IF any required comparison for the obligation is not evaluable under the frozen protocol THEN NOT_EVALUABLE_UNDER_FROZEN_TRANSPORT_CONTRACT
ELSE IF every required comparison satisfies the frozen obligation THEN SUPPORTED
ELSE classification is invalid because evaluator inputs are incomplete

ordered_precedence: IF any ST_A1..ST_A5 obligation or ROLE_PRESERVATION_FIREWALL is NOT_SUPPORTED THEN SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_NOT_SUPPORTED_ON_FROZEN_SUITE
ELSE IF any ST_A1..ST_A5 obligation or ROLE_PRESERVATION_FIREWALL is NOT_EVALUABLE_UNDER_FROZEN_TRANSPORT_CONTRACT THEN NOT_EVALUABLE_UNDER_FROZEN_TRANSPORT_CONTRACT
ELSE IF ST_A1..ST_A5 are all SUPPORTED and ROLE_PRESERVATION_FIREWALL is satisfied THEN SEMANTIC_TRANSPORT_SUPPORTED_ON_FROZEN_SUITE

family_specific_expectations_are_not_res.C1: tests ST-A1 carrier invariance while preserving provenance differences
family_specific_expectations_are_not_res.C2: tests ST-A2 semantic separation under same carrier family
family_specific_expectations_are_not_res.C3_C4: test ST-A3 rejection of wrong constitution/proxy and ST-A5 non-promotion of nonconstituted content
family_specific_expectations_are_not_res.C5: tests ST-A4 semantic invariance plus provenance recoverability and provenance-sensitive admission
family_specific_expectations_are_not_res.C6: tests ST-A5 partial/conflict preservation and ST-A3 unresolved admission
family_specific_expectations_are_not_res.C7: tests role-preservation firewall against schema/field-shape crossing
